title: El Camarón de Escuinapa, MEXI TV
comment: camaron-escuinapa (MEXITV): muelle de pescadores con puestos de camarón en Escuinapa, Sinaloa. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.ROSARIO_LIZARRAGA: Mexican woman from Sinaloa, shrimp seller, 63 years old, tanned brown skin, curly grey hair tied back with a red bandana, small gold hoop earrings, a turquoise sleeveless blouse, a white apron, a long dark skirt, rubber sandals, her hands empty.
chars.ITZEL_LIZARRAGA: Mexican woman from Sinaloa, 27 years old, tanned skin, long curly dark-brown hair, a yellow t-shirt, denim shorts over leggings, white sneakers, her hands empty.
chars.BRAULIO_ZAZUETA: Mexican man from Sinaloa, 31 years old, light skin, short spiky black hair, a thin mustache, a white western shirt with a black yoke, a thick gold chain, dark jeans, black cowboy boots, his hands empty.
chars.TEODORO_ZAZUETA: Mexican fishing fleet boss from Sinaloa, 66 years old, tall, fair sun-tanned skin, blond-grey hair, a blond-grey mustache, a white straw cowboy hat, a light-blue linen shirt, beige trousers, brown boots, holding dark sunglasses.

locs.LOC_MUELLEESCUINAPA: Fishing dock on a lagoon in Escuinapa, Sinaloa, in the late afternoon: a weathered wooden dock with a small shrimp stall under a tarp, plastic trays of fresh shrimp on ice, nets and colorful fishing boats moored behind, palm trees and calm water, golden light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
